media.alt: Annual Convocation of the Aga Khan University

content.text: The annual convocation of The Aga Khan University (AKU) is being held on Saturday, November 15th 1999. The AKU is Pakistan's first private international university, providing higher education and developing research pertinent to Pakistan and the developing world at internationally accepted academic standards. The Chief Justice of the Sindh High Court, Mr. Justice Nazim Hussain Siddiqui, will be the chief guest on the occasion. The Keynote speech will be given by Dr Peter George, President, McMaster University

This year, with the graduation of 71 students from the 12th batch of the five-year MBBS programme, the Medical College will have graduated 811 doctors. There will also be 6 students graduating from the Masters in Epidemiology Programme Additionally, 30 graduates from the Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED) will be receiving their Masters of Education (M.Ed.). AKU-IED offers professional training to teachers and managers of schools and school systems. These graduates will join over 2000 AKU trained healthcare professionals, researchers and teacher educators who have been promoting the welfare of the people of Pakistan and other developing nations.

The School of Nursing shares the Medical College's goals of delivering high quality care in both hospital and community settings. It will be graduating 86 nurses from its Diploma Programme, bringing the total number to 1,182, as well as 25 nurses from its advanced B.Sc. Nursing Degree Programme. A highlight of the ceremony this year will be the distribution of Awards of Distinction to mark the 20" anniversary of the School of Nursing.
